title: campaign.requested
description: PAYLOAD of the `campaign.requested` envelope. Topic: campaign.lifecycle.requested. The journey root that kicks off the core loop (§3.1): a vendor (or Famit Tenant Zero via the Origin Connector campaign.requested mapping, §3.4) asks GROWTH OS to run a campaign. Triggers the ResearchWarRoom -> CIB. correlation_id on the envelope is minted here for the campaign-level journey.

campaign_request_id.description: GROWTH OS id for this request (referenced as campaign_request_ref by the CIB §9.3).

origin_ref.description: Source-system id when raised via the Origin Connector (Famit campaign_id, §3.4). Absent for native requests.

objective.description: Campaign objective. Phase-1 default = leads (§21). Maps to platform objective in the campaign-compiler (§10.1).

business.description: Minimal business hint to seed BusinessUnderstanding (§9.2). The War Room enriches this; full truth lives in the Vendor Brain (§9.4).

industry_pack.description: Industry pack id (§18) selected at onboarding; drives persona/offer/compliance/KPI defaults.

offer_hint.description: Optional offer the vendor wants to lead with; OfferStrategist (§9.2) may improve it.

audience_size.description: Hint of addressable audience / lead list size when known (e.g. Famit leads CSV row count, §3.4).

budget_hint.description: Vendor-stated budget intent in INR paise. The BudgetStrategist + War-Game (§14.5) derive min_viable_test; the compiler refuses to launch untestable budgets (§10.1, §13.4).

channels_hint.description: Channels the vendor wants (the channel_plan is decided by the CIB). Phase-1 = meta + whatsapp (CTWA).

requested_by.description: Echo of the human/system that requested (also on envelope.actor); kept for the report narrative.
